prompt: Your prompt says "NEVER use ellipses" because the output goes to a text-to-speech engine. What is the best improvement?

options.text: Repeat the rule in capital letters at the start and end of the prompt.
Say that ellipses are forbidden by company policy and leave it there.
Explain why: the response is read aloud by a text-to-speech engine that cannot pronounce ellipses.
Remove the rule and post-process the output with a regular expression only.

explanation: Giving the motivation behind an instruction lets Claude understand your goal and generalize from it (for example, avoiding other symbols a speech engine cannot read), which usually beats a bare prohibition.
